# Leaflet 1.9.4

Bundled from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/ using the distribution linked by the official Leaflet quick-start guide. JavaScript and CSS SHA-256 hashes were verified against that guide. License: BSD-2-Clause, retained in LICENSE and the library header. Map tiles load separately from OpenStreetMap; no third-party script or stylesheet is loaded at runtime.
